units.source_text: 柏木移近纸烛，拆看公主复信。

en.t: Kashiwagi moved the paper lamp closer, opened the princess's reply, and read it.

units.source_text: 但见手笔还很稚弱，风致却甚优美。

en.t: Her handwriting still looked rather childish and weak, but its grace was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 信中写道：“闻君患病，不胜怅惘。

en.t: The letter said, "Hearing that you are ill has filled me with deep sadness.

units.source_text: 然而无可奈何，惟有临风悬想而已。

en.t: Yet there is nothing I can do, so I can only face the wind and think longingly of you.

units.source_text: 来书有‘爱永存’之语，须知

en.t: In your letter you wrote of 'love everlasting'; please understand that
